leads.title: Build for Bharat Fellow (AI/Engineering/Design)
leads.posting: Bharat Digital Anywhere The Build for Bharat Fellowship is a paid, six-month programme that places early-career engineers, designers and AI practitioners inside government departments. Fellows work alongside government teams on real projects, improving public systems used by millions of people. What fellows get: Real-world experience: Work on live government projects, interact with users and understand how public services operate. Learning and mentorship: An orientation, regular reviews and expert office hours with practitioners such as Kailash Nadh (CTO, Zerodha), Rukmini S (Founder, Data for India) and Devanshi Sihare (TinkerLabs). A community: Learn alongside other fellows and connect with people working in public technology. Some projects from past cohorts Official statistics: Built MoSPI’s eSankhyiki MCP server , making official statistics accessible to AI assistants. Rural libraries: Developed Arivu Mitra, a WhatsApp companion for Gram Panchayat librarians in Karnataka using Whatomate . Transport: Built a transit analytics dashboard for Chennai’s transport authority and NHAI's Annual Pass web and app which has helped sell 1 Cr Annual Passes in a year. Citizen services: Redesigned Tamil Nadu’s e-Sevai services, IRCTC ticket UI, e-swathu, etc., to improve the citizen experience. Explore more projects Fellowship at a glance Duration : January–June 2027 (6 months, on-site) Location: On-site at a partner government department Stipend: ₹40,000 per month Eligibility: Indian citizens graduating in 2027 or who completed their latest degree in 2024–2026, with demonstrable skills in Engineering, Design or AI Application deadline: 18 October 2026, 11:59 PM IST Apply here: https://bharatdigital.org/fellowship

Bharat Digital â Build for Bharat Fellowship Get Involved Programme Build for Bharat Fellowship 2027 Past Cohorts Past Projects Cohort 2027 Applications for 2027 are now live. Apply now Best viewed on Desktop × Home Fellowship Build for Bharat Fellowship 2027 Past Cohorts Past Projects About Get Involved Build for Bharat Fellowship 2027 A six-month paid fellowship inside a government department, working alongside government partners, solving tasks for real-world impact. Apply for 2027 cohort Read the FAQs We aim to identify and train early-career public-interest technologists who can strengthen, modernise and humanise the digital systems solving India's most urgent public and governance challenges. What the fellowship holds 01 Orientation and onboarding Before you start, an orientation in public service, policy and what it takes to put technology inside complex social systems. You hear from some of India’s top technologists, policymakers, designers and administrators. Much of it is tacit knowledge you won’t find anywhere else, there to ready you for the six months ahead. Watch last year’s orientation ↗ The 2026 cohort 02 Build Once deputed to a government team, you work alongside the people already there, on real problems and real codebases. Most fellows ship changes to government systems within their first month, and a few go on to redesign or launch services used by millions of Indians. This is the real thing, not a hackathon or a side-project. A session with an anganwadi group · RDPR Karnataka 03 Mentorship Throughout the fellowship, you have regular mentoring and check-ins with Bharat Digital’s core team. On top of that, you get office hours with some of India’s leading public-spirited technologists and designers. Previous mentors include Kailash Nadh (CTO, Zerodha), Rukmini S (Data for India; author of Whole Numbers and Half Truths ) and Devanshi Sihare (Head of Social Impact, TinkerLabs). Fellows with mentor Rukmini S · Data for India 04 Field visits Field visits are an integral part of the fellowship. Not a line of code gets changed until you’ve understood the problem first-hand: visited the offices and rooms where your technology will be used, and met the people it will affect. By the end, you won’t just have immersed yourself in India’s grassroots; you’ll understand how public systems are actually conceived, and how they touch the ground. StoryWeaver Lite with children in a Gram Panchayat library · RDPR Karnataka 05 Community building We believe deeply in the power of community. We create opportunities for fellows to get to know one another across cohorts, and to plug into the wider public-technology ecosystem through events, talks and one-on-one sessions with founders and practitioners. A mixer for the 2025 and 2026 cohorts 06 Public technology careers Six months inside a department changes what you can do next, and often what you want to do next. We work closely with you to find that next step, so you can keep building in the public-technology ecosystem: in government, in research labs, or at the leading tech-for-good organisations using technology to improve public systems. leads.title: RF Engineer
leads.posting: Indiana Microelectronics LLC | RF Engineer | West Lafayette, IN | ONSITE | Full-time | Relocation assistance available Indiana Micro is a small electronics company working on tunable RF filters and radio-frequency front-end (RFFE) systems for interference mitigation. We’re looking for an RF engineer to design, simulate, test, and optimize RF hardware—from filters, amplifiers, and mixers through integrated front-end systems. You’ll work with systems engineers, firmware developers, and customers from early architecture through production. Looking for: - 3+ years of hands-on RF engineering, hardware design, or wireless communications experience. - Strong RF/microwave fundamentals and experience with tools such as HFSS, Keysight ADS, Microwave Office, and Altium. - Practical lab experience with network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and related test equipment. - Familiarity with Python or MATLAB for test automation and data analysis. - Bachelor’s or master’s in EE, computer engineering, electrical engineering technology, or a related field. Benefits include retirement benefits and PTO. Email cuppys@indianamicro.com to apply.

Tunable and Microwave Filters | Radio Frequency Consulting | West Lafayette, IN - Indiana Microelectronics, LLC Indiana Microelectronics | West Lafayette, IN Offcanvas × Home Our Technology Tunable Microwave Filters Tunable Microwave Filter Offerings Static Microwave Filters About Us Contact Us slide-blue.jpg Tunable and Static Microwave Filters for Spectrum Cleanup and Interference Mitigation Learn More slide-green.jpg Radio Frequency (RF) Consulting Modeling, Simulation & Design Learn More OUR TECHNOLOGY Indiana Micro designs and manufactures real-time reconfigurable microwave filters (RMFs) that adapt to constantly changing contested and congested RF environments. Tunable filter applications are spectrum cleanup and the mitigation of co-site interference and jamming signals. Indiana Micro’s current efforts are focused in the VHF through Ku Bands (30 MHz to 20 GHz). The need for tunable filters at higher frequencies is steadily increasing. Learn More Tunable Microwave Filters Indiana Micro's tunable filters are called reconfigurable microwave filters, or RMFs. RMFs are unique in that both the center frequency (fc) and the bandwidth (Δf) are independently tunable in real time. More details Static Microwave Filters Indiana Micro designs high quality factor static filters in a variety of substrates, including Rogers, low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) and glass. Indiana Micro has experience in designing static filters up to 20 GHz. More details About Us Indiana Micro researches, develops and produces tunable and static microwave filters. Our specialty is tunable microwave filters, which we call Reconfigurable Microwave Filters, or RMFs. The center frequency (fc), bandwidth (Δf), and configuration (bandpass vs bandpass) of an RMF is computer controlled with typical tuning times of less than 10 microseconds. Founded in 2009, Indiana Micro is located in the Purdue University Research Park in West Lafayette, IN. Indiana Micro maintains cooperative R&D relationships with Purdue and several other universities. Indiana Micro’s customers include the US Army, US Navy, US Air Force, the Missile Defense Agency (MDA), NASA, and several major defense prime contractors. More About Us
